title_orig: Слово обличительное против агарянского заблуждения и против измыслившего его скверного пса Магомета
title_es: Discurso de refutación del error agareno y de Mahoma, que lo inventó (el título original contiene un insulto personal: «скверного пса»)
title_en: Discourse of refutation against the Hagarene error and against Muhammad who devised it (own translation; no PD English found)
date: c. 1520s; before 1525 per azbyka.ru annotation («написано до 1525 г.»); not checked against a critical edition
language: Russian (1910 translation). Original language (Greek or Slavonic) NOT established in this session
genre: Polemical treatise (first of the two 'Слова' in «Два слова против Магомета»)
edition_original: Сочинения преподобнаго Максима Грека в русском переводе, Sergiev Posad: Holy Trinity-St Sergius Lavra, 1910, vol. 2, «Два слова против Магомета», pp. 38–82 (source note on azbyka.ru); paraklit.org cites it as «Догматико-полемические сочинения», гл. 6. Kazan 1859 edition (Сочинения ... изданные при Казанской духовной академии, ч. 1): NOT READ (rusneb.ru blocked behind a VPN notice).
edition_english: NONE found in public domain. Own literal translation supplied for each passage.
licence: azbyka.ru shows epub/pdf download and a source note; no licence statement seen. Text is a 1910 imperial-era printing (public domain by age, team to confirm).
authenticity_note: Attributed to Maxim in the 1910 Lavra edition (as cited by azbyka.ru) and on paraklit.org. Not checked against a critical edition or manuscript. Authorship UNVERIFIED independently.
notes: Insult in the title («скверного пса», 'vile dog'); the Slovo 2 title has «пса Магомета». Quoted passages avoid the insults as argument, but some contain the adjective «скверный» ('foul/wicked') and devil-talk. The Muhammad 'legend' passages (Jewish and Arian teachers; the dove) are polemical narratives, not verified history. CROSS-CHECK: the pigeon episode and the sword dialogue (maxim_p06) are present in the azbyka.ru text only; paraklit.org and k-istine.ru omit them. k-istine.ru (https://k-istine.ru/library/maksim_greek-01.htm, read; cp1251; older orthography; title without the insult) is a second Russian copy with different wording in places.

title_orig: Слово 2-е, о том же, к благочестивым против богоборца и пса Магомета; здесь же отчасти и сказание о кончине века сего
title_es: Segundo discurso, sobre el mismo tema, a los piadosos, contra Mahoma; incluye en parte un relato sobre el fin de este siglo (título con insulto: «пса Магомета»)
title_en: Second discourse, on the same matter, to the pious, against Muhammad; partly an account of the end of this age (own translation)
date: c. 1520s; before 1525 per azbyka.ru annotation; not checked against a critical edition
edition_original: Same 1910 Lavra edition as maxim_slovo1 (vol. 2); paraklit.org cites it as «Догматико-полемические сочинения», гл. 7
edition_english: NONE found in public domain. Own literal translation supplied.
licence: As maxim_slovo1: azbyka.ru shows no licence statement; 1910 printing.
authenticity_note: As maxim_slovo1: attributed to Maxim in the cited editions; not checked against a critical edition. UNVERIFIED independently.
notes: Contains the most quotable eschatological claim: Muhammad as the 'false prophet' and 'forerunner of the God-fighting Antichrist' (see maxim_p01). The azbyka.ru annotation summarises the work with the same claim.

title_orig: Ответы христиан против агарян (мусульман), хулящих нашу православную христианскую веру
title_es: Respuestas de los cristianos a los agarenos (musulmanes) que blasfeman contra nuestra fe ortodoxa cristiana
title_en: Answers of Christians to the Hagarenes (Muslims) who revile our Orthodox Christian faith (own translation)
date: not given in the source read
language: Russian (text on paraklit.org; origin of that text not established)
genre: Apologetic guidance: how to answer Muslim objections from the Gospel
edition_original: Cited on paraklit.org as «Догматико-полемические сочинения», гл. 8 (publisher and year not stated on the page). Not identified with the 1910 Lavra text.
licence: No licence statement seen on paraklit.org; a devotional reproduction site.
authenticity_note: Attributed to Maxim on paraklit.org; not checked against a critical edition. UNVERIFIED.
notes: The paraklit.org page has an editorial gloss «[«Евангелие истинно» — Коран]» in another paragraph. It is not Maxim's text and is not in the quotes used here. The azbyka.ru page does not contain this text (only Slovo 1 and 2 were on it).
